operator_scope: live camera; encode retained, payload read back, block released. The clip on the card is stock uncompressed and was not modified.
notes: The framing check earned its place on its first live use: it refused the assembly because tile 11 did not end with EOI at its declared length. That was not a bug but a property of the camera's output -- the final tile is padded to align the total -- and the check is now written to allow zero padding after EOI and nothing else.
release did not recognise a block retained by a --keep encode, because the arming guard it reused only knows the scratch phase. Fixed during the session.

explicitly_established.claim: the camera's own hardware lossless-JPEG bitstream decodes to exactly the source frame: 2,110,240 samples, identical SHA-256. The engine's output is genuinely lossless.
the canonical segment 0 contract works with camera-produced tiles, not just host-encoded ones
the camera lays its tiles contiguously from the arena base: all twelve SOI markers sit exactly at the cumulative offsets, delta zero
the camera rounds the LAST tile's declared byte count up so the payload total is 512-byte aligned; 11 zero bytes follow the final EOI and 1,284,096 is 2,508 x 512
three DRAM windows alias the same memory and all show the codec's output: the 0x4 handle, the 0x8 view the shell worker calls uncached, and the 0xC cached alias
--keep retains the block and release frees it and records FREE, with the hook restored and the shell alive afterwards

explicitly_not_established: that CPU writes are visible to the SD DMA: the window comparison was inconclusive by construction, because both views agreed and the cache need never have held those lines
that the shell worker's 0x8-plus-dsb idiom applies to the card path; it is proven for USB DMA, which is a different engine
anything about writing a compressed frame to the card; this run only read memory back
more than one frame, one scene, one geometry
whether the 11-byte tail rounding is fixed at 512 or derived from something else
in-camera playback, which remains impossible for tiled Compression=7
